title: Sales Data Analyst
text: Sales Data Analyst at MYOB (Melbourne, ; Full Time; salary: Competitive Salary Package). Sales Data Analyst Melbourne Who are we? We are a tech company that exists to make business life easier. Our team is continually growing, inventing and disrupting conventions. We believe business can do amazing things it’s our job to help them. This is MYOB. You’ll be part of the Sales Operations team, which is responsible for providing data and reporting to drive growth at MYOB. This team is part of our wider Clients and Partners team who lead the way in marketing and selling our highly regarded practice solutions and online business tools. The opportunity This role provides crucial insights and support to the sales teams and contributes to better sales outcomes for our most crucial channels. You will achieve this in a collaborative way working closely with your team to achieve the outcomes requires. We move with high agility and pace, which provides the opportunity to expose data and insights that drive tangible commercial outcomes. Do you want to be part of this journey? The role • Working with key stakeholders & sales channel owners to collect key requirements & prioritise requests • Using best practice BI to build and enhance reporting, and provide insights to drive commercial outcomes • Manage and maintain data integrity for sales tools, reporting, and CRM systems What you will bring • Strong SQL and BI knowledge. You are experience in writing and understanding complex queries • Demonstrable experience using Business Intelligence tools such as Qlik, Power BI or Tableau • Sales and commercial mindset and ability to work with both operational and technical stakeholders If you want to work and collaborate where opinions are valued and your ideas can make a difference, you should work at MYOB. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company.
